top_moves.title: Grok 4.7 slips past its Sept 12 target
top_moves.body: Musk had pointed to a Sept 12 launch for the 2.1T-parameter Grok 4.7, but posted Sept 11 that it needs "a few more days to cook," citing the model giving up on solvable hard tasks too early and insufficient rigor in checking its own work.

top_moves.title: GitHub Copilot sets Oct 2 model deprecation wave
top_moves.body: Copilot is retiring Gemini 3.6 Flash, Kimi K2.7 Code, and Claude Opus 4.7 on Oct 2, replacing them with Gemini 3.8 Flash, Kimi K3, and Claude Opus 5 respectively — any client automation pinned to a model name needs a config check before then.

top_moves.title: Notion adds per-workspace AI model governance
top_moves.body: Workspace owners on Business/Enterprise plans can now restrict which AI models Notion Agent and Custom Agents are allowed to use, and set a default model for Custom Agents — a direct lever for clients worried about which vendor model touches their data.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: No new dated announcement today; GPT-6 Astra and the GPT-Live-1 voice API continue rolling out.
providers.detail: GPT-6 Astra (released Sept 3) remains the flagship, scoring 72.6% on OSWorld 2.0 computer-use in about 40 minutes per task versus 65.7% at ~75 minutes for GPT-5.6 Sol. GPT-Live-1 brought full-duplex voice with 12 new real-time voices and native transcripts to the API. No fresh Sept 12–13 development surfaced.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: No new dated announcement today; Claude Fable 5.1's cache-pricing cut and Enterprise Smart Reports keep rolling out.
providers.detail: Claude Fable 5.1 (Sept 1) and Claude Mythos 5.1 cut cache-read pricing to a quarter of every other Claude model. Admin API user-management for Enterprise orgs is now out of beta, and Smart Reports (beta, Enterprise) analyzes team usage, cost, and repeated patterns worth packaging as shared skills. No new item since.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: No new dated announcement today; Gemini 3.7 Flash and the Live agent features continue their rollout.
providers.detail: Gemini 3.7 Flash (GA Aug 13) targets complex agentic tasks; Gemini 3.5 Transcribe and Gemini Omni Flash (video generation/editing) are both GA. Gemini Live is expanding into Personal Intelligence, Daily Brief, and hands-free inbox management. No fresh Sept 12–13 item.

providers.name: xAI
providers.headline: Grok 4.7 launch slips past its Sept 12 target date.
providers.detail: Musk said Sept 2 that Grok 4.7 was "10 days out," pointing to Sept 12, then reversed on Sept 11, saying it needs more time — the model reportedly gives up on solvable hard tasks too early and isn't rigorous enough checking its work. Grok 4.6 remains the shipping flagship; Grok Bot (enterprise autonomous workers with access/audit controls) launched Sept 3.

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: No new headline today.
providers.detail: Muse Code exited beta Sept 1 and Muse Spark 1.3 shipped Sept 2, still closed-weights with no HuggingFace release as of Sept 4. An open-weights release remains undated.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: No new headline; Leanstral 1.5 retires Sept 30.
providers.detail: Mistral OCR 4.1 is GA and Agentic Search (a retrieval layer for navigating and verifying complex documents) has launched. Leanstral 1.5, the Lean 4 formal-proof model, is scheduled for retirement Sept 30.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: No material dated update today.
providers.detail: Recent capability continues rolling out: Computer in Email, 20+ new licensed finance data sources, and Brain (an agentic Markdown knowledge wiki). No new dated item surfaced for Sept 12–13.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: No new dated announcement today; GPT-6 Astra continues rolling into Copilot Cowork/Studio.
providers.detail: GPT-6 Astra joined Copilot Cowork and Copilot Studio model choices starting Sept 4. Reusable skills now follow users across SharePoint/OneDrive with built-in evaluation. Model-driven Answer Cards (weather, sports, finance, news) are targeting general availability this month.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: Sets Oct 2 model deprecation wave across Copilot experiences.
providers.detail: Gemini 3.6 Flash, Kimi K2.7 Code, and Claude Opus 4.7 are being retired Oct 2 in favor of Gemini 3.8 Flash, Kimi K3, and Claude Opus 5. Copilot app/CLI now honor content exclusions to keep sensitive code out of agentic context, and multi-root workspace support is experimental.

providers.name: Cursor
providers.headline: No new headline today.
providers.detail: Cursor's most recent move was self-hosted machines (Sept 2), keeping tool execution on customer infrastructure — relevant to clients with data-residency requirements. Nothing new since.

providers.name: Gamma
providers.headline: No release since June 12 — extended quiet stretch continues.
providers.detail: Gamma 2.0's February relaunch (faster performance, better collaborative editing) remains the last major update. Notion page-to-Gamma transform is still available.

providers.name: Notion AI
providers.headline: Ships per-workspace AI model governance controls.
providers.detail: Business/Enterprise workspace owners can now restrict which models Notion Agent and Custom Agents may use, and set a default model for Custom Agents — separate controls for each surface. Standalone Notion Mail is winding down Sept 22, folding back into core Notion.

persistent_signals.text: xAI — Grok 4.7 launch delay — 2 weeks running (still not shipped as of Sept 11–12; rigor/early-quitting issues cited both weeks)
GitHub Copilot — model lifecycle churn — 2 weeks running (MAI-Code-1-Flash retired Sept 10; now a broader Oct 2 deprecation wave announced)

month_themes.then: Meta's Muse Glimmer landed as its first open-weight model since abandoning Llama; Notion's Workers billing flipped to a credit model overnight; a dual Aug 17 shutdown (Anthropic Prompt Tools API + Gemini image models) forced same-week migrations.
month_themes.now: A marquee model launch (Grok 4.7) is visibly slipping rather than shipping on schedule; providers are running scheduled model-deprecation cycles (GitHub Copilot's Oct 2 wave, Mistral's Sept 30 Leanstral retirement) instead of surprise cutoffs; and vendors are adding model-choice governance controls (Notion) as clients get pickier about which model touches their data.

habits.shift: Cheaper cache reads on Fable 5.1 make it economical to keep full runbook context loaded across long editing sessions — draft and revise in place rather than re-summarizing context each time.
NIST's SP 1353 draft (AI use in CSF 2.0 reporting) is open for comment through Sept 16 — worth a quick summarize-and-flag pass now, before the window closes, for any client program mapped to CSF.

With Copilot's Oct 2 model swap-out (Gemini 3.8 Flash, Kimi K3, Claude Opus 5) and Cursor's self-hosted execution option, this is a good week to re-check any vendor architecture doc that names a specific model — several names are about to go stale.
No change in default tool this week; keep proposal drafting on Claude for narrative quality.
Gamma remains quiet (85+ days); no reason to switch off the current deck workflow.
GPT-Live-1's native transcripts plus 12 real-time voices make it a solid option for recording a narrated client walkthrough with a text record generated for free.

habits.task: Client advisory on AI data risk
habits.tool: Notion AI governance controls / vendor DPAs
habits.shift: Notion's new per-workspace model allow-listing is a concrete, screenshot-able control to point risk-averse clients toward when they ask "which AI models touch our workspace data."

community.signal: 1.1M-member community still actively working through prompting techniques for long documents and Claude Code tips in the wake of the Aug 31 performance-degradation incident.
community.so_what: Sustained engagement with Claude Code workflow tricks reinforces it as the default coding driver, but the lingering incident chatter is a reminder to sanity-check output quality on long sessions.

community.signal: 821k-member subreddit averaging roughly 1K points and 255 comments per top post this week, per subreddit analytics — no single breakout post identified, general interest in local/on-device models steady.
community.so_what: Consistent (not spiking) interest in local models — useful context if a client raises on-prem/data-residency alternatives to cloud AI.

community.signal: No specific high-engagement thread surfaced in today's search; weekly OpenAI-shipping trackers continue chronicling a steady release cadence rather than a single viral moment.
community.so_what: Quiet week for OpenAI-specific community reaction — nothing actionable to flag to clients.

watch.title: Grok 4.7 revised launch date
watch.body: Watch for Musk's next ship-date signal after the Sept 11 slip; 2.1T params and SpaceX engineering training data make this a meaningful jump if quality issues get resolved.

watch.title: GitHub Copilot Oct 2 model deprecation
watch.body: Gemini 3.6 Flash, Kimi K2.7 Code, and Claude Opus 4.7 retire from Copilot experiences; audit any client automation or IDE config pinned to those model names before the switch.

watch.title: Mistral Leanstral 1.5 retirement — Sept 30
watch.body: The Lean 4 formal-proof model is being retired; low relevance to most clients but worth a mention if any engagement uses it for formal verification work.

watch.title: NIST SP 1353 comment period closes Sept 16
watch.body: Draft quick-start guide for using AI in NIST CSF 2.0 analysis and reporting is open for public comment through Sept 16 — a fast-approaching window for clients who want a voice in the guidance.

watch.title: Notion Mail standalone app winding down — Sept 22
watch.body: The standalone Notion Mail inbox (web/desktop/iOS) is being folded back into core Notion; flag for any client relying on it as a separate app.
